title: Contrek: Vectorizing 10 Billion Pixels on a Raspberry Pi 5 with Just 4 GB RAM
snippet: I've been developing Contrek , a C++ library for extracting polygon contours from raster images and merging contours obtained by processing different parts of an image. One of the problems I wanted to solve was handling very large rasters without having to load everything into memory. Contrek can extract contours directly or merge contours produced by other libraries, including OpenCV. It supports parallel processing of image tiles and reconstructs polygons crossing tile boundaries, including complex shapes and holes. But one of its main strengths is memory efficiency. Streaming vectorization Contrek can process an image in horizontal stripes, reconnecting contours across stripe boundaries and progressively writing completed polygons to disk.
